title: Polynomial-time computability of packed records
statement: For every finite-state Boolean Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $C,e,c,A,d$, the function sending each Boolean word $x$ to its packed records is computable in polynomial time.
replaced: For every source machine and parameters $C, e, c, A, d$, the function sending an instance to its complete packed preparation data, header, trajectory, and visit table, is polynomial-time computable; every retained copy and capture is charged by the native composition calculus.
